name: ledger5
description: Pure chain length: five independent one-line bugs in four modules, each with its own failing tests and no shared code paths. isbn10_check_digit weights the digits 9..1 instead of 10..2 (off by one in a constant; breaks the check digit, validation and the ISBN-13 conversion), is_overdue uses >= so a loan is overdue on its due date (operator; also breaks can_renew), fine caps with max() instead of min() (wrong builtin), rank sorts ascending because reverse=False (constant), and label numbers positions from 0 instead of 1 (`number = position` drops the `+ 1`; off by one). Twelve tests fail (3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 2), eighteen pass. The ledger must form and close five goals in sequence without regressing any of them.
